description: THE STRETCH property (M3 keystone, worlds/marmalade/stretch_sequence.gd), driven by --stretch (dev/capture force-arm, fires ~3s after load regardless of dream count -- STRETCH {"phase":"start","forced":true}). No input for the first ~21s: both Pip and Otto sit at spawn until the sequence bubble-lifts them (core/rescue/bubble_effect.gd, no receipt of its own -- watch the PLAYER_POS trajectory instead) to the village square (~-60/-58.6, 0.45, 4.0) and holds them there through the whole cat choreography + rooftop-plate shift. Expected receipts, in order: STRETCH phase=start (forced:true); phase=nook_revealed (ground solid FIRST, before any tween -- same lesson bramble's rollover_sequence.gd already learned live); phase=plates_shifting; phase=arch (the cat's scale-up mid-choreography); phase=plates_shifted; phase=resettle (cat easing back to her exact rest transform); phase=route_open (cine push toward the newly-relocated RoofB0-3 chain); phase=end. Zero RESCUE lines throughout -- both seats float to solid ground and hold, never fall. PHASE 2 (teleport-assisted, ~22.5s in, well after the sequence's own phase=end, per the same allowance bramble_ascent.json's Phase 2 used for the mountain ascent): BOTH seats teleport onto each relocated plate in turn -- RoofB0_NEW (20.6,11.6,5.0), RoofB1_NEW (23.2,13.6,7.0), RoofB2_NEW (25.8,15.6,9.0), RoofB3_NEW (28.4,17.6,11.0) -- then onto the AtticNook platform (31.0,19.6,13.0). Both seats move together on purpose: a single-seat-only teleport this far from the OTHER (stationary) seat trips core/coop/seat_manager.gd's own frustum-leash (CameraRig.leash_broken -> SeatManager warps the stray player back beside their partner) -- caught live on a first pass (PLAYER_POS snapped back toward the village square mid-hold) -- core/** is out of this pass's territory to touch, so the script accounts for it instead, exactly as a real two-player session would (co-op players explore together). Seat 2's Z offset is +0.6 on the four RoofB plates (2.4m square footprint, marmalade.gd ROOF_SIZE -- a wider offset walked seat 2 off the edge on a first pass, caught live via a falling PLAYER_POS trail) and +1.6 at the AtticNook (4.5m square, StretchSequence.NOOK_SIZE -- room for the wider spacing). Each pair landing HOLDING its position for 3s (no fall, no lasting WARP) proves that plate/the nook is solid ground at its POST-STRETCH location, and that the horizontal hop between consecutive plates (3.28m, computed from marmalade.gd's CHAIN_STEP) stays under the 3.5m stick+jump floor law even though this proof itself uses teleports rather than a live jump input. Ends holding on the nook platform, beside its lantern/cushion/moth_small dressing.
